description: Curated, offline CTI known-bad indicator list for the rule-exposure (CTI) axis. Real, documented bad IPs; loaded by services.cti.providers.LabOfflineProvider so the CTI axis is demonstrable and reproducible offline (no key, no network). The live AbuseIPDBProvider layers real-world reputation ON TOP when CTI_PROVIDER_KEYS=abuseipdb=<key> is set in .env (worst-verdict-wins, so a key only adds coverage). Override this path with CTI_INDICATORS_PATH. 185.220.101.1 is the indicator the lab benchmark rules reference (MALICIOUS_IP).
